title: Make a local client
summary: createClient connects the JavaScript SDK to the chosen project API.
introduction: createClient connects the JavaScript SDK to the chosen project API. Your task: Find the local public key in your practice project status.
learningObjectives: Find the local public key in your practice project status.
Explain the example for make a local client

blocks.text: createClient connects the JavaScript SDK to the chosen project API. Use the local project URL and its public client key for this exercise.

Use the Supabase local CLI with its required container runtime, then run supabase init and supabase start in a practice project. Use the local URL and public key reported by its status command. SQL runs in the local database tools.
Read the code step by step

items: The first createClient argument is the local API address.
The second is a public client key from the same local project; it still depends on database permission checks.

blocks.text: After replacing the placeholder with the local public key from supabase status, the client can make permitted requests.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Never replace the placeholder with a service-role key in browser code. A public key works together with RLS.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Find the local public key in your practice project status.
